sections.label: Upload Settings
sections.help: Which systems an upload types into the jet.

sections.label: Capture Settings
sections.help: Where F10-map captured points are inserted (app-side only, never uploaded).

sections.label: Waypoints
sections.help: Hornet waypoints 0-59 (PRECISE DDM). FA18Page does not re-create a null Waypoints; WaypointsPage dereferences it.

sections.label: Sequence
sections.help: SEQ1-3 built from waypoint numbers. FA18Page does not re-create a null Sequences; SequencePage dereferences it.

sections.label: CMS
sections.help: Countermeasure dispenser (ALE-47) programs 1-5, mode and EW HUD option.

sections.label: Radios
sections.help: COMM1 (Radio1) and COMM2 (Radio2): 20 presets each plus guard and active channel. FA18Page does not re-create a null Radios; RadiosPageControl dereferences it.

sections.label: FCR
sections.help: APG-73 air-to-air settings per weapon (AMRAAM, Sparrow, Sidewinder), declutter, RWR, BRA.

sections.label: PrePlanned
sections.help: JDAM/JSOW/SLAM pre-planned missions PP1-6 per station 2/3/7/8 (DMS coordinates) and SLAM steerpoints.

sections.label: HMD
sections.help: JHMCS reject mode and per-symbol reject levels.

sections.label: Misc
sections.help: Bingo, bullseye, altitude warnings, BLIM, TACAN, ILS, HSI map and laser codes; each group has its own ToBeUpdated flag.

fields.label: Aircraft code
fields.help: Always "FA18C"; ConfigLoader picks the C# type from it.

fields.label: Preset format version
fields.help: Always 2. Missing/1 together with a missing Upload sends the file to the V1 converter.

fields.label: Kneeboard notes
fields.help: Free text (CRLF line breaks) shown in the in-game kneeboard dialog; sent when Upload.Kneeboard is ticked. Not a system: Load-from-file never copies it.

fields.label: Waypoints
fields.help: Type every waypoint (lat/long precise, elevation) on HSI > DATA > WYPT.

fields.label: Sequences
fields.help: Rebuild SEQ1-3 for the sequences whose EnableUploadN is ticked.

fields.label: Countermeasure Programs
fields.help: EW HUD option, dispenser mode, programs marked ToBeUpdated and the selected program.

fields.label: Radios
fields.help: COMM1/COMM2 presets, guard, active channel or manual frequency.

fields.label: Pre Planned Coordinates
fields.help: JDAM/JSOW/SLAM PP missions (and SLAM steerpoints) for stations with a store type set.

fields.label: HMD
fields.help: HMD reject mode and per-symbol reject levels (HMD must be on).

fields.label: FCR
fields.help: Radar settings for AMRAAM, AIM-7 and AIM-9, declutter, RWR and BRA.

fields.label: Misc
fields.help: Items whose ToBeUpdated flag is ticked (bingo, bullseye, baro/radar warn, TACAN, ILS, laser codes) plus BLIM TAC and HSI map.

fields.label: Kneeboard
fields.help: Send the preset name, summary and KneeboardNotes to the in-game kneeboard.

fields.label: Nav points capture mode

options.label: Add to end of first gap

fields.help: Where F10-map captured points land (SteerpointCaptureMode). App-side only, never uploaded. When exporting a route, leave AddToEndOfList (0) or AddToRange starting after the last route sequence so later captures do not overwrite route points.

fields.label: Target points capture mode

options.label: Add to end of first gap

fields.help: Same as NavPointsMode for points captured with "Add TGT" (Target=true).

fields.label: Nav points range start
fields.help: First sequence used when NavPointsMode = Add to range. Suggest last route sequence + 1.

fields.label: Target points range start
fields.help: First sequence used when TgtPointsMode = Add to range.

Filled from the planned route. Hornet waypoints are numbered 0-59 (GetFirstAllowedSequence 0, last 59). WP0 is the jet's initial/alignment position; map route point i (1-based) to Sequence i so WP0 is left alone, max 59 route points (fewer if Misc.BullseyeWP, default 59, is used for the bullseye). Sequence must be unique; keep the list sorted by Sequence.

fields.label: Waypoints
fields.help: One entry per route point, in route order. Hornet waypoints are numbered 0-59 (GetFirstAllowedSequence 0, last 59). WP0 is the jet's initial/alignment position; map route point i (1-based) to Sequence i so WP0 is left alone, max 59 route points (fewer if Misc.BullseyeWP, default 59, is used for the bullseye). Sequence must be unique; keep the list sorted by Sequence.

fields.label: Waypoint number
fields.help: Hornet waypoints are numbered 0-59 (GetFirstAllowedSequence 0, last 59). WP0 is the jet's initial/alignment position; map route point i (1-based) to Sequence i so WP0 is left alone, max 59 route points (fewer if Misc.BullseyeWP, default 59, is used for the bullseye). Sequence must be unique; keep the list sorted by Sequence.

fields.label: Name
fields.help: Route point name. Not uploaded (the Hornet has no waypoint names); shown in the DTC list and kneeboard only, so any length works; keep it short (<= 20 chars) for the kneeboard. Must be non-empty for the DTC editor.

fields.label: Latitude
fields.help: DDM thousandths, e.g. "N 42°10.630’" (U+00B0, U+2019). Uploaded in PRECISE mode.

fields.label: Longitude
fields.help: DDM thousandths with 3-digit degrees, e.g. "E 042°28.840’".

fields.label: Elevation
fields.help: Feet MSL (route altitude or ground elevation). Editor range 0-25000; negatives are not typed.

fields.label: Time over steerpoint
fields.help: Route TOT/TOS as "HH:MM:SS" or null. Stored and shown on the kneeboard only; not uploaded.

fields.label: Target
fields.help: Set from the route point's target flag. Display only ("TGT"), not uploaded; also useful for choosing which points feed PrePlanned PP coordinates (convert to DMS).
Build SEQ1 from the planned route: Mode 2 (Use range) with Waypoints [firstSeq, lastSeq], or Mode 3 with the route sequences in fly order. Mode 1 uses every waypoint in list order.

fields.label: Sequence 1 mode
fields.help: Build SEQ1 from the planned route: Mode 2 (Use range) with Waypoints [firstSeq, lastSeq], or Mode 3 with the route sequences in fly order. Mode 1 uses every waypoint in list order.

fields.label: Sequence 1 waypoints
fields.help: Mode 2: [from] or [from, to] (to defaults to the last waypoint; only existing waypoints are added). Mode 3: unique waypoint numbers in fly order. null for Mode 1. Values are waypoint Sequence numbers 0-59.

fields.label: Upload sequence 1
fields.help: Rebuild SEQ1 when Upload.Sequences is ticked. Set true for every sequence built from the route.
Optional extra route (e.g. alternate/egress). Leave Mode 0 and EnableUpload2 false unless the dashboard plans more than one route.

fields.label: Sequence 2 mode
fields.help: Optional extra route (e.g. alternate/egress). Leave Mode 0 and EnableUpload2 false unless the dashboard plans more than one route.

fields.label: Sequence 2 waypoints
fields.help: Mode 2: [from] or [from, to] (to defaults to the last waypoint; only existing waypoints are added). Mode 3: unique waypoint numbers in fly order. null for Mode 1. Values are waypoint Sequence numbers 0-59.

fields.label: Upload sequence 2
fields.help: Rebuild SEQ2 when Upload.Sequences is ticked. Set true for every sequence built from the route.
Optional extra route (e.g. alternate/egress). Leave Mode 0 and EnableUpload3 false unless the dashboard plans more than one route.

fields.label: Sequence 3 mode
fields.help: Optional extra route (e.g. alternate/egress). Leave Mode 0 and EnableUpload3 false unless the dashboard plans more than one route.

fields.label: Sequence 3 waypoints
fields.help: Mode 2: [from] or [from, to] (to defaults to the last waypoint; only existing waypoints are added). Mode 3: unique waypoint numbers in fly order. null for Mode 1. Values are waypoint Sequence numbers 0-59.

fields.label: Upload sequence 3
fields.help: Rebuild SEQ3 when Upload.Sequences is ticked. Set true for every sequence built from the route.

fields.label: Programs
fields.help: Exactly 5 programs (constructor-bound; keep all six members). Only written to the jet when the dispenser is on and in MAN at upload time.

fields.label: Flare qty
fields.help: Flares per salvo, 0-99.

fields.label: Chaff qty
fields.help: Chaff per salvo, 0-99.

fields.label: Interval
fields.help: Seconds between salvos, 0.25-5.00 in 0.25 steps (UI regex ^[0-5][.,][0257][05]$).

fields.label: Repeat
fields.help: Number of salvos, 0-99.

fields.label: Program this slot
fields.help: Only programs with this ticked are typed into the jet.

fields.label: Dispenser mode
fields.help: CMSMode; the UI stores null for Unchanged. Program settings only apply if the mode is Manual.

fields.label: Selected program
fields.help: Program left selected after upload, 1-5. Default 0 (no selection in the UI; the uploader would still send program 0) — set 1-5 when uploading CMS.

fields.label: Enable EW on HUD
fields.help: Boxes the EW HUD option; always applied when Upload.CMS.

fields.label: COMM1 presets
fields.help: null or a list of presets (Number 1-20, unique). Unset channels are simply absent.

fields.label: Name
fields.help: Stored/kneeboard only; not uploaded.

fields.label: Frequency
fields.help: MHz as a string with a dot and 3 decimals ("251.000", "42.250"); bands FM 30.000-87.995, VHF 108.000-173.975, UHF 225.000-399.975, 5 kHz steps. FA18 does not run the 2-to-3-decimal fix-up on load (the uploader pads).

fields.label: COMM1 manual frequency
fields.help: Used when Mode = Frequency. MHz as a string with a dot and 3 decimals ("251.000", "42.250"); bands FM 30.000-87.995, VHF 108.000-173.975, UHF 225.000-399.975, 5 kHz steps. FA18 does not run the 2-to-3-decimal fix-up on load (the uploader pads).

fields.label: COMM1 active channel
fields.help: String "1".."20" or "G"; used when Mode = Preset.

fields.label: COMM1 guard
fields.help: Enable the guard receiver.

fields.label: COMM1 mode
fields.help: RadioMode. 0 (default) = untouched; a radio with no presets, no guard, no selection and Mode 0 is skipped.

fields.label: COMM2 presets
fields.help: null or a list of presets (Number 1-20, unique). Unset channels are simply absent.

fields.label: Name
fields.help: Stored/kneeboard only; not uploaded.

fields.label: Frequency
fields.help: MHz as a string with a dot and 3 decimals ("251.000", "42.250"); bands FM 30.000-87.995, VHF 108.000-173.975, UHF 225.000-399.975, 5 kHz steps. FA18 does not run the 2-to-3-decimal fix-up on load (the uploader pads).

fields.label: COMM2 manual frequency
fields.help: Used when Mode = Frequency. MHz as a string with a dot and 3 decimals ("251.000", "42.250"); bands FM 30.000-87.995, VHF 108.000-173.975, UHF 225.000-399.975, 5 kHz steps. FA18 does not run the 2-to-3-decimal fix-up on load (the uploader pads).

fields.label: COMM2 active channel
fields.help: String "1".."20" or "G"; used when Mode = Preset.

fields.label: COMM2 guard
fields.help: Enable the guard receiver.

fields.label: COMM2 mode
fields.help: RadioMode. 0 (default) = untouched; a radio with no presets, no guard, no selection and Mode 0 is skipped.

fields.label: Enable RWR
fields.help: Show RWR on the radar attack format.

fields.label: Enable BRA
fields.help: Show bearing/range/altitude on the radar attack format.

fields.label: Stations
fields.help: Dictionary keyed by station number (JSON string keys). The constructor creates 2, 3, 7, 8; keep exactly those.

fields.label: Store type
fields.help: StationType. Stations with Type 0/1 or no enabled PP are skipped. README: store types must match the real loadout on ALL stations.

fields.label: Station
fields.help: Equals the dictionary key.

fields.label: PP missions
fields.help: PP1-PP6, keyed "1".."6".

fields.label: PP latitude
fields.help: DMS with hundredths of seconds (Coordinate.ToHornetPreplannedFormat), e.g. "N 42°10’37.80”" (U+2019 minutes, U+201D seconds). Not DDM.

fields.label: PP longitude
fields.help: DMS hundredths with 3-digit degrees, e.g. "E 042°28’50.40”".

fields.label: PP elevation
fields.help: Target elevation, feet MSL.

fields.label: PP enabled
fields.help: Only enabled PPs (with Lat/Lon set) are uploaded.

fields.label: PP notes
fields.help: Stored/kneeboard only.

fields.label: SLAM steerpoints
fields.help: Exactly 5 mission steerpoints, used only for SLAM / SLAM-ER stations that also have an enabled PP.

fields.label: Use coordinate
fields.help: true: use Lat/Lon/Elev; false: use WaypointNumber (UI "Lat/Lon/Elev" vs "Waypoint").

fields.label: Waypoint
fields.help: Existing Hornet waypoint number (UI offers Waypoint 0-19) when UseCoordinate is false.

fields.label: Steerpoint latitude
fields.help: DMS with hundredths of seconds (Coordinate.ToHornetPreplannedFormat), e.g. "N 42°10’37.80”" (U+2019 minutes, U+201D seconds). Not DDM.

fields.label: Steerpoint longitude
fields.help: DMS hundredths with 3-digit degrees, e.g. "E 042°28’50.40”".

fields.label: Steerpoint altitude
fields.help: UI mask 00000.

fields.label: Steerpoint notes
fields.help: Not editable in the UI; leave null.

fields.label: Reject mode
fields.help: HMDRejectMode selected after upload.

fields.label: Reject settings
fields.help: Dictionary symbol name -> lowest reject level at which it is still shown (exact key text, WINDOW keys are padded to 13 chars). Missing keys use the built-in default listed in keyOptions. Must not be null (the HMD page throws when a level is clicked); empty {} = all defaults.

fields.label: Level
fields.help: Normal = shown in NORM, Reject1 = removed at REJ 1, Reject2 = removed at REJ 2.

fields.label: Enable bullseye
fields.help: Designate BullseyeWP as the bullseye on the HSI.

fields.label: Bullseye waypoint
fields.help: Waypoint number (0-59) used as bullseye. If the dashboard exports a bullseye, add it as a waypoint (e.g. 59) outside the route range and point this at it.

fields.label: Radar ALT warning
fields.help: The radar-altimeter knob only steps up to 5000 ft.

fields.label: Tactical AP bank-limit
fields.help: Set BLIM to TAC (bank limit off NAV).

fields.label: ILS channel
fields.help: 1-20; 0 = not set (skipped even if ILSToBeUpdated).

fields.label: Set laser codes
fields.help: Needs the FLIR pod powered.

fields.label: TGP laser code
fields.help: 4 digits: first 1-2, others 1-8.

fields.label: LST code
fields.help: 4 digits: first 1-2, others 1-8.
